By changing it from `ManuallyDrop<Alloc>` back to a normal field, `ptr::drop_in_place(inst)` will now run `Alloc::drop` as part of the automatic field drop sequence. `Alloc::drop` calls `RegionInternal::drop_alloc`, which returns the slot to the region freelist before `drop_in_place` has completed dropping the rest of the `Instance` fields. The previous `ManuallyDrop::take` pattern intentionally delayed `Alloc::drop` until after all other fields had been destroyed, and this PR removes that guarantee.
